name: Narain
bio: Sunil Kumar, known by his stage name Narain, is an Indian film actor, who has starred in Malayalam and Tamil films. He made his debut in Adoor Gopalakrishnan's Nizhalkuthu, followed by performances in Malayalam films 4 the People, Achuvinte Amma, and Classmates.

credits.overview: An unusual bond grows between 60-year-old Dalit worker Azhagan and eight-year-old middle class girl Radha. However, Azhagan's proximity to Radha and her mother doesn't go down well with Radha's father.

credits.title: Mugamoodi

credits.overview: Chandrashekhar lives alone in a dark and violent city. Even with crime occurring all around him, he withdraws from all responsibility and lives quietly. credits.overview: Freedom fighter and politician Mohammed Abdul Rahiman leads the revolution in Kerala.
